# MUTXRI TERMINAL

> MUTXRI TERMINAL is a browser based market terminal for African equity markets, covering 938 securities listed on four exchanges, with source labelled prices, financial statements, filings, dividends and ratios.

MUTXRI TERMINAL is built for analysts, investors and financial institutions researching listed African companies, so that one company can be researched in one workspace instead of several exchange sites, an annual report PDF, a regulatory disclosure service and a spreadsheet.

Market data is end of day or delayed, never real time. Every figure records the source it came from, and where no verified free source exists the gap is left as a gap rather than filled with an estimate.

The terminal is free during beta and no account is needed to explore it. Order routing is shown as a demonstration and is still in development; no order is placed.

## Start here

- [MUTXRI TERMINAL](https://mutxriterminal.com/): what the terminal covers, its capabilities, and the four markets.
- [Data methodology](https://mutxriterminal.com/methodology.html): where each figure comes from, how sources are attributed, and what is deliberately left blank.
- [Guide](https://mutxriterminal.com/guide.html): how to drive the terminal, panel by panel.

## Coverage

- Nairobi Securities Exchange, Kenya (KES): 64 securities
- Nigerian Exchange, Nigeria (NGN): 146 securities
- Johannesburg Stock Exchange, South Africa (ZAR): 362 securities
- Egyptian Exchange, Egypt (EGP): 366 securities

938 securities in total, of which 881 are companies with financial statements. Statements are collected from exchange filing libraries; 380 filing documents are held.

## The terminal

- [Open the terminal](https://mutxriterminal.com/terminal/): the application itself. Panels are market heatmap, screener, trade ticket, financial statements, company comparison, news, regulatory announcements, global commodities, bonds and foreign exchange.

## Data principles

- Prices are end of day or delayed, never real time.
- Every figure carries its source. Statement files record the source document and its date.
- Missing or unreconciled values are published as gaps or annotated. No value is invented to fill a cell.
- Historical price series are append only. Deeper history is never overwritten with shallower data.

## Honest limits

- This is not investment advice and not a licensed advisory service.
- Trading is a demonstration. No order reaches a market.
- Coverage depth varies by exchange. Some price series begin later than an issuer's listing date because no free source reaches further back.
- Some panels show an explicit no feed state rather than a substitute value.
